FN-ARZ4D7S-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 136
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Chris Pringle
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 01/19/2026
House Bill 136 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of the Governor's
office to certify immediate danger to the public health, safety, or welfare to establish an
emergency rule. This bill would otherwise not affect state or local funding.
